ios.desc:
In 1997, a groundbreaking study by psychologists Arthur Aron, Ph.D., and Elaine Aron, Ph.D., revealed a fascinating way to foster intimacy between strangers. Published in the *Personality and Social Psychology Bulletin*, their research demonstrated that answering a specific set of 36 increasingly personal questions could accelerate feelings of closeness, intimacy, and even love.

Inspired by this idea, we created With. An app designed to help you build deeper connections through a curated set of cards. Each card contains thoughtfully crafted questions that encourage meaningful conversations and reveal more about each other as you progress.

With offers over 200 cards across different levels of intimacy, tailored for various setups such as family gatherings, friends, and more. Whether you’re looking to deepen your relationships or gain insight into your own thoughts and feelings, With provides a versatile tool for connection and self-discovery.

Cards can also be used as prompts for journaling in a physical notebook or for moments of personal reflection on the couch when you find yourself with a bit of free time.

While these questions aren’t a magic formula for falling in love, and they can’t replace the time needed to build true trust and commitment, they do create a sense of closeness and can be incredibly enlightening. Use “With” for your next date night, intimate dinner party, or personal reflection, and experience the joy of genuine connection.

Please be mindful that some questions may be triggering, especially for those experiencing depression or anxiety.

Download “With” and start fostering deeper relationships and self-awareness today.
